ranking.note: Raised to P2: documents a privacy feature's prerequisites and scope limits, where absent/fragmented guidance can lead operators to over-trust private broadcast.

Raised to P2: corrects privacy-relevant documentation (persistent I2P identity exposure, wallet txs not covered) that could otherwise lead operators to a wrong conclusion; same consequence class as #35858.
Internal developer documentation with no user-facing misdirection; sits below the privacy/config docs despite its high standalone score.
Raised to P4->P3: the current text is factually wrong against the codebase (58/129 LogError calls fatal, per #30348) and keeps re-triggering review debates, which is more than cleanup.

inconsistencies: #35858 and #36348 overlap: both document that -privatebroadcast applies only to sendrawtransaction and both touch doc/i2p.md. #35858 moves i2p.md/tor.md privacy guidance into a new doc/privacy.md, so it should be reviewed first and #36348's transient-address note folded into the new layout; otherwise the two will conflict.

#35480 and #35518 are by the same author and both address parts of issue #14278 (notification semantics). They are complementary rather than duplicative; reviewing them in one pass is cheaper, with #35518 (-*notify ordering) first since it states the general rule and #35480 the ZMQ-specific case.

#30361 (LogError guidance) and #36101 (error handling strategy) both touch project-wide error conventions; if #36101's approach is settled first it may change the wording wanted in developer-notes, but #30361 fixes a concrete doc/code mismatch and should not be held behind the disputed design doc.
result.notes: The band spread is intentional: one high-leverage design doc and two privacy-feature docs at P2, four substantive but deferrable clarifications at P3, and two maintenance/syntax items at P4. #36101's disputed status and NACKs were ignored for banding, per the definitions; the problem it addresses (recurring, unresolved error-handling debates blocking subsystem PRs) is what places it first.
